insight: Trades Zapier's one-shot triggers for agents that sit waiting on an inbox or calendar, then act with some judgment.
name: Lindy
tagline: Agentic automation. Long-running agents instead of one-shot triggers.
description: Builds AI agents that wait for emails, calendar invites, or webhooks — then take multi-step actions on your behalf. The 'agentic Zapier' pitch; strong for ops workflows that need judgement, not just routing.
